page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.u2i-c1m4.3xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance belonging to the ecs.u2i server family. Running on the KVM hypervisor, this instance features an x86_64 architecture powered by an Intel Xeon processor with a clock speed of 2.7 GHz. It is configured with 12 dedicated vCPUs and 48.0 GB of system memory, maintaining a balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio with 4.0 GB of memory allocated per core.

The instance does not include any bundled local storage or integrated GPU hardware, meaning all storage requirements must be met via network-attached volumes. It provides a baseline network bandwidth of 8 Gbps and does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures consistent compute resources without sharing processing power with other tenants.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the balanced resource density of the ecs.u2i-c1m4.3xlarge makes it a practical option for workloads requiring steady compute and memory allocations without the premium cost of specialized storage or accelerator hardware. Tradeoffs include the complete reliance on external storage and the lack of hardware acceleration. This profile is suitable for general-purpose workloads, including web serving, application servers, and medium-scale enterprise applications.
